42985.meaning1: ultimate state of degradation; very lowest condition; total ruination
42985.meaning2: ultimate state of degradation; very lowest condition

examples.text: ettāvatā kho, ambaṭṭha, khattiyo paramanihīnataṃ patto hoti, yadeva naṃ khattiyā khuramuṇḍaṃ karitvā bhassapuṭena vadhitvā raṭṭhā vā nagarā vā pabbājenti.

kathaṃ aparipakkato? so pan'āyam'āhāro evarūpe okāse nidhānam'upagato yāva aparipakko hoti, tāva tasmiññ'eva yathāvuttappakāre paramandhakāratimise nānākuṇapa-gandhavāsita-pavanavicarite atiduggandhajegucche padese

42987.meaning1: who has reached the highest goal; who has attained the ultimate end
42987.commentary: (NIDD1a) anuttaraṃ samāpattiṃ samāpajjituṃ amataṃ paṭilābhaṃ pattattā paramapattippatto.

examples.text: yo'pi'ssa sāvako uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto tam'pi sāvakaṃ abbhatītaṃ kālaṅ'kataṃ upapattīsu byākaroti, asu amutra upapanno, asu amutra upapanno'ti.

abhijānāmi kho pan'āhaṃ, sāriputta, caturaṅgasamannāgataṃ brahmacariyaṃ caritā, tapassī sudaṃ homi paramatapassī, lūkho sudaṃ homi paramalūkho, jegucchī sudaṃ homi paramajegucchī, pavivitto sudaṃ homi paramapavivitto.

42989.grammar: adj, fem nom sg of paramapāsāvī, comp (+loc)
42989.meaning1: bringing forth the very best; delivering the best (in)
42989.commentary: (SNa) paramapāsāvinī'ti ettha pasavanaṃ pasāvo, pavattī'ti attho. pasāvo eva pāsāvo. paramo pāsāvo paramapāsāvo, so assā atthī'ti paramapāsāvinī. nacce ca gīte ca uttamapavatti seṭṭhakiriyā, uttamam'eva naccaṃ naccati, gītaṃ vā gāyatī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: sā kho pan'assa janapadakalyāṇī paramapāsāvinī nacce, paramapāsāvinī gīte.

42990.meaning1: bringing forth the very best; delivering the most excellent (in)
42990.commentary: (SNa) paramapāsāvinī'ti ettha pasavanaṃ pasāvo, pavattī'ti attho. pasāvo eva pāsāvo. paramo pāsāvo paramapāsāvo, so assā atthī'ti paramapāsāvinī. nacce ca gīte ca uttamapavatti seṭṭhakiriyā, uttamam'eva naccaṃ naccati, gītaṃ vā gāyatī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: sā kho pan'assa janapadakalyāṇī paramapāsāvinī nacce, paramapāsāvinī gīte.

42991.commentary: (NIDD1a) paramapuriso'ti uttamapuriso, paramaṃ vā paṭilābhaṃ pattattā uttamaṃ pattabbaṃ arahattapaṭilābhaṃ patto anuttarapuññakkhettabhūto uttamapuriso, ten'ev'atthena paramapuriso.

examples.text: yo'pi'ssa sāvako uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto tam'pi sāvakaṃ abbhatītaṃ kālaṅ'kataṃ upapattīsu byākaroti, asu amutra upapanno, asu amutra upapanno'ti.

abhijānāmi kho pan'āhaṃ, sāriputta, caturaṅgasamannāgataṃ brahmacariyaṃ caritā, tapassī sudaṃ homi paramatapassī, lūkho sudaṃ homi paramalūkho, jegucchī sudaṃ homi paramajegucchī, pavivitto sudaṃ homi paramapavivitto.
atha kho, ambaṭṭha, rājā okkāko udānaṃ udānesi, sakyā vata, bho, kumārā, paramasakyā vata, bho, kumārā'ti. tadagge kho pana ambaṭṭha sakyā paññāyanti, so ca nesaṃ pubbapuriso.

atthaṃ upaparikkhato dhammā nijjhānaṃ khamanti, dhammanijjhānakkhantiyā sati chando jāyati, chandajāto ussahati, ussāhetvā tuleti, tulayitvā padahati, pahit'atto samāno kāyena c'eva paramasaccaṃ sacchikaroti, paññāya ca naṃ ativijjha passati.

pūraṇena, bhante, kassapena chaḷabhijātiyo paññattā, kaṇh'ābhijāti paññattā, nīl'ābhijāti paññattā, lohit'ābhijāti paññattā, halidd'ābhijāti paññattā, sukk'ābhijāti paññattā, paramasukk'ābhijāti paññattā.

42997.meaning1: extremely delicate; most refined; (comm) completely free of suffering

examples.text: sukhumālo ahaṃ, bhikkhave, paramasukhumālo accantasukhumālo. mama su'daṃ, bhikkhave, pitu nivesane pokkharaṇiyo kāritā honti.

ayaṃ kho, āvuso, maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā, etassa param'assāsassa sacchikiriyāyā'ti. bhaddako, āvuso, maggo bhaddikā paṭipadā, etassa param'assāsassa sacchikiriyāya. alañ'ca pan'āvuso sāriputta, appamādāyā'ti.

42999.meaning1: gained the ultimate relief; taken the highest solace

examples.text: yato kho, āvuso, bhikkhu channaṃ phass'āyatanānaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā anupādāvimutto hoti, ettāvatā kho, āvuso, param'assāsappatto hotī'ti.
